packages.assetDecision: Tempo.Blazor.All intentionally ships no feature static web assets directly; assets remain owned by their feature packages and host apps include the CSS/script links they render.

summary.recommendation: Split the current all-in-one Tempo.Blazor package into a smaller core package plus feature packages for the largest editors and specialized dependency groups.
summary.preferredIdentityStrategy: Keep Tempo.Blazor as the lean core package in the next major version and add Tempo.Blazor.All as the compatibility metapackage.
summary.mainReason: The current package includes large editor code, large static web assets, and feature-specific dependencies that many applications do not need.

recommended.reason: The most visible NuGet ID becomes smaller by default, which is the actual goal of the split.

alternative.reasonNotRecommended: This preserves compatibility but keeps the package named Tempo.Blazor large for new users.

keepAreas: Inputs except optional specialized dependency groups
packages.serviceBoundary: Core-only services: ITmLocalizer, ThemeService, ToastService, DragDropService, core notifications. No Diagram, Wireframe, Modeling, DocumentEditor, or NotionEditor provider registrations.

css: CSS isolation static web asset bundle included through the host app .styles.css pipeline
